pairs.target: luó dí shuō jīnwǎn bùxǔ tǎ wéi dài liáng gān .
pairs.english: Luodi said Tavi was not allowed to bring a measuring rod tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻说今晚不许塔维带量杆。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài kèzhàn ménqián , shǒulǐ tí zhe yìxiǎobāo lìzǐ táng ,
pairs.english: He stood outside the inn, holding a small packet of chestnut sweets in his hand,
pairs.hanzi: 他站在客栈门前，手里提着一小包栗子糖，

pairs.target: shuō zìjǐ tángxiōng zài hébiān bǎi le zhuō , shuí zài yìbiān chī yìbiān bǎ lù kuān xiě xiàlái , shuí jiù huíqù tì yù hé téng zhǐ .
pairs.english: saying his cousin had set up a table by the river; anyone who measured out the road's width in writing while eating again would go back and copy papers for Yuhe.
pairs.hanzi: 说自己堂兄在河边摆了桌，谁再一边吃一边把路宽写下来，谁就回去替郁禾誊纸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kànkàn kōngshǒu , wèn tā bǎ rén xiǎng chéng shénme le .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down at his empty hands and asked what sort of person Luodi took him for.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看看空手，问他把人想成什么了。

pairs.target: " xiǎng chéng yí jìnmén xiān zhǎo nǎér bú duì de bái jiē rén . "
pairs.english: “A White Steps person who looks for something wrong as soon as he comes through the door.”
pairs.hanzi: “想成一进门先找哪儿不对的白阶人。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái yào fǎnbó , huàdàozuǐbiān , xiān xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to argue, but with the words on his lips, he laughed first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来要反驳，话到嘴边，先笑了。

pairs.target: yù hé cóng hòutou jīngguò , tīngjiàn zìjǐ míngzì , shuō bié ná tā xiàrén , zhǐ jīntiān yǐjīng xiě wán , shuí dōu biétì tā tiān .
pairs.english: Yuhe passed behind them, heard her name, and told them not to use her to frighten people: today's papers were already finished, and nobody was to add any for her.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾从后头经过，听见自己名字，说别拿她吓人，纸今天已经写完，谁都别替她添。

pairs.target: chūn shì hái méi dào zuì máng de yìtiān , hébiān què xiān rènào qǐlái .
pairs.english: The spring market had not reached its busiest day, but the riverside was already lively.
pairs.hanzi: 春市还没到最忙的一天，河边却先热闹起来。

pairs.target: tānzi yán dī chù pūkāi , mài zhúqì , yān guǒ , bùdài hé xiǎoháizi xǐhuan de zhuànlún .
pairs.english: Stalls spread along the lower ground, selling bamboo utensils, pickled fruit, cloth ribbons and the spinning wheels children liked.
pairs.hanzi: 摊子沿低处铺开，卖竹器、腌果、布带和小孩子喜欢的转轮。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn yíjià mùlún , biān zhuǎn biān bǎ jǐzhī xiǎoniǎo táiqǐ , xiǎngdào pà wò , yòu xiǎngdào rúguǒ zìjǐ mǎihuíqù , zuìxiān bèi chāikāi de duōbàn jiùshì tā .
pairs.english: Tavi saw a wooden wheel lifting little birds as it turned and thought of Pavo. If he bought it and took it back, it would probably be the first thing taken apart.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见一架木轮，边转边把几只小鸟抬起，想到帕沃，又想到如果自己买回去，最先被拆开的多半就是它。

pairs.target: luó dí tángxiōng de zhuōbiān yǐjīng wéi le jǐgè rén , liǎngjié shéng fàngzài qiǎnpán lǐ ,
pairs.english: Several people had gathered around Luodi's cousin's table, where two lengths of rope lay in shallow dishes.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻堂兄的桌边已经围了几个人，两截绳放在浅盘里，

pairs.target: bǐ de shì xiān jiěkāi , zhào yuányàng zhā huí , bùxǔ gāncuì lā chéng sǐjié .
pairs.english: The contest was to undo them and tie them back the same way, without simply pulling them into a jammed knot.
pairs.hanzi: 比的是先解开、照原样扎回，不许干脆拉成死结。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde qízhōng yì jié , shēnshǒu yì mō , zhīdào luó dí yòu ná píngcháng bǎng chē de dōngxī lái zhànpiányi .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized one length. Reaching out to feel it, he knew Luodi was again gaining an advantage by using the rope he normally tied carts with.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得其中一截，伸手一摸，知道罗荻又拿平常绑车的东西来占便宜。

pairs.target: " huàn yìgēn . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Use a different one,” he said.
pairs.hanzi: “换一根。”他说。

pairs.target: luó dí lìkè jiào tā bié lài , tángxiōng què zhēn cóng hòutou qǔchū yì jié xīn de , ràng liǎngbiān dōu shì guòshǒu , zài kāishǐ .
pairs.english: Luodi instantly told him not to make excuses, but his cousin fetched a new length from behind the stall, let both sides try it, then started the contest.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻立刻叫他别赖，堂兄却真从后头取出一截新的，让两边都试过手，再开始。

pairs.target: dìyīhuí luó dí yíng , dìèrhuí tǎ wéi réng màn yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Luodi won the first round. In the second, Tavi was still a little slower.
pairs.hanzi: 第一回罗荻赢，第二回塔维仍慢一点。

pairs.target: dìsānhuí , tā zhōngyú méi ràng duǎn tóu fān dào lǐ cè , jié wěnwěn zhā huíqù , táitóu shí , luó dí de shǒu hái méi líkāi .
pairs.english: The third time, he finally kept the short end from turning inward. His knot was firmly tied again when he looked up; Luodi's hands had not yet moved away.
pairs.hanzi: 第三回，他终于没让短头翻到里侧，结稳稳扎回去，抬头时，罗荻的手还没离开。

pairs.target: tā yíngdé hěnzhǎi , xiào dé què bǐ zìjǐ xiǎngxiàng zhōng dàshēng .
pairs.english: His victory was narrow, but he laughed louder than he had imagined he would.
pairs.hanzi: 他赢得很窄，笑得却比自己想象中大声。

pairs.target: tángxiōng tuī lái yíkuài lìzǐ táng , luó dí shuō zhào guījǔ zhī gòu yíkuài , bié bǎ yí shèng jiǎng chéng zìjǐ lián shū sāncì .
pairs.english: His cousin pushed over a chestnut sweet. Luodi said the rules allowed only one; Tavi must not turn one victory into a tale of Luodi losing three times in a row.
pairs.hanzi: 堂兄推来一块栗子糖，罗荻说照规矩只够一块，别把一胜讲成自己连输三次。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng táng bāi chéng liǎngbàn , dì tā yíbàn , shuō zìjǐ zhī huì jiǎng dìsānhuí .
pairs.english: Tavi broke the sweet in half, gave him one half, and said he would only tell people about the third round.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将糖掰成两半，递他一半，说自己只会讲第三回。

pairs.target: yánhé de jǐzhǎn tān dēng zhèshí àn xiàqù .
pairs.english: A few stall lamps along the river dimmed just then.
pairs.hanzi: 沿河的几盏摊灯这时暗下去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yào shōutān , táitóu què jiàn gèng duō rén wǎng shuǐbiān kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi thought the stalls were closing, but when he looked up, more people were watching the water's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为要收摊，抬头却见更多人往水边看。

pairs.target: dīǎi shùcóng jiān fúqǐ yípiàn qīnglǜ de xiǎo guāng , xiānshì jǐlì , suíhòu yuèláiyuè mì , xiàng yǒurén bǎ yibǎ xìsuì xīngdiǎn dǎo jìn yèlǐ .
pairs.english: Tiny blue-green lights rose among the low bushes, a few at first, then thicker and thicker, as though someone had poured a handful of scattered stars into the night.
pairs.hanzi: 低矮树丛间浮起一片青绿的小光，先是几粒，随后越来越密，像有人把一把细碎星点倒进夜里。

pairs.target: tāmen bìng bú zhàoliàng zhěngtiáo hé , zhī zài jìnchù yì shǎn yi shǎn , jiāng yè biān hé qiǎnshuǐ de wénlù diǎn chūlái .
pairs.english: They did not light the whole river, only flickered nearby, picking out leaf edges and the ripples in the shallows.
pairs.hanzi: 它们并不照亮整条河，只在近处一闪一闪，将叶边和浅水的纹路点出来。

pairs.target: " qīng jǐ dēngé . " luó dí shuō , " guò zhèzhènzǐ jiù duō . bié náshǒu qù zhuā , fěn zhānmǎn xiùzǐ , huíqù xǐ dé xiǎng kū . "
pairs.english: “Green-ridged lantern moths,” Luodi said. “There are plenty around this time. Don't grab them with your hands. The dust gets all over your sleeves; washing it out will make you want to cry.”
pairs.hanzi: “青脊灯蛾。”罗荻说，“过这阵子就多。别拿手去抓，粉沾满袖子，回去洗得想哭。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zhe méi dòng .
pairs.english: Tavi stood without moving.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站着没动。

pairs.target: tā jiàn guò shānshàng de dēng , yě jiàn guò chuán dēng tuō zhe dǎoyǐng zǒu , kě nàxiē guāng dōu dé yǒurén diǎn , yǒurén tiān yóu .
pairs.english: He had seen lamps on the mountains and boat lamps trailing their reflections, but those lights all needed someone to light them and add oil.
pairs.hanzi: 他见过山上的灯，也见过船灯拖着倒影走，可那些光都得有人点、有人添油。

pairs.target: yǎnqián de liàngdiǎn cóng yè bèi fēi qǐ , yòu luòdào lìng yípiàn yè shàng , méiyǒu shuí zhèng zhàn zài hòutou tì tāmen shǒuyè .
pairs.english: The bright specks before him flew up from the backs of leaves and settled on others, with nobody standing behind them to keep a night watch for them.
pairs.hanzi: 眼前的亮点从叶背飞起，又落到另一片叶上，没有谁正站在后头替它们守夜。

pairs.target: hébiān yǒurén shuō jīnnián bǐ qùnián zǎo , yě yǒurén shuō shì zìjǐ qùnián huílái wǎn le , méi kànjiàn .
pairs.english: Someone by the river said they were earlier this year than last; someone else said he had returned late last year and missed them.
pairs.hanzi: 河边有人说今年比去年早，也有人说是自己去年回来晚了，没看见。

pairs.target: xiǎoháizi shēnshǒu shù , shù dào shíjǐ biàn chóng lái , pángbiān dàrén yě méi bǐ tāmen shù dé míngbái .
pairs.english: Children held out their hands and counted, starting again after a dozen or so; the adults beside them did no better.
pairs.hanzi: 小孩子伸手数，数到十几便重来，旁边大人也没比他们数得明白。

pairs.target: lùdēng méi miè , guò rén de shíjiē réng zhàozhe , àn xiàqù de zhǐshì kào shùcóng nà jǐzhǎn tān dēng , ràng rén kàn dé gèng qīngchǔ xiē .
pairs.english: The street lamps stayed lit, still lighting the steps people used; only the few stall lamps near the bushes had dimmed, letting everyone see more clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 路灯没灭，过人的石阶仍照着，暗下去的只是靠树丛那几盏摊灯，让人看得更清楚些。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zuòzài bùyuǎnchù chī miàn , xī shàng fàng zhe jiālǐ jì lái de xiǎo zhǐ , láihuí fān le liǎngcì .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng sat nearby eating noodles, turning a little paper sent from home over twice on his knee.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡坐在不远处吃面，膝上放着家里寄来的小纸，来回翻了两次。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu guòqù , jiàn shàngtóu huà zhe yìpái wāi yá , rěnbúzhù wèn shì shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi walked over, saw a row of crooked teeth drawn on it, and could not help asking what it was.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走过去，见上头画着一排歪牙，忍不住问是什么。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō nǚér diào le dìyīkē yá , pà zìjǐ kànbùdǒng , hái jiāng quēkǒu huà dé bǐ zuǐ dōu dà .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said his daughter had lost her first tooth; afraid he would not understand, she had even drawn the gap larger than the mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说女儿掉了第一颗牙，怕自己看不懂，还将缺口画得比嘴都大。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán yòu xiào le , píngcháng jiǎng jiǎnchá fànwéi shí nàzhǒng lìsuǒ jìn quán méiyǒu le .
pairs.english: He finished and laughed again, entirely without the briskness he normally had when explaining inspection boundaries.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完又笑了，平常讲检查范围时那种利索劲全没有了。

pairs.target: luó dí tángxiōng hǎn zhe shōu shéng , tǎ wéi guòqù bāngmáng , bùzhībùjué bǎ jǐzhī qiǎnpán bǎi dé zhěngqí .
pairs.english: Luodi's cousin called for help putting the ropes away. Tavi went to help and unconsciously arranged the shallow dishes neatly.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻堂兄喊着收绳，塔维过去帮忙，不知不觉把几只浅盘摆得整齐。

pairs.target: luó dí kànjiàn , shuō méi dài liáng gān yě méiyòng , shǒu zìjǐ huì gànhuó .
pairs.english: Luodi noticed and said leaving the measuring rod behind was no use: his hands would find work by themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻看见，说没带量杆也没用，手自己会干活。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi lǐ tā , zuìhòu liú le yìzhī wāi pán , gùyì zhuǎngěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: Tavi ignored him, leaving one crooked dish at the end and deliberately turning it for him to see.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没理他，最后留了一只歪盘，故意转给他看。

pairs.target: huí kèzhàn hòu , tā xiān gěi mǐlā hé yīwén gè xiě yíyè ,
pairs.english: Back at the inn, he first wrote a page each to Mira and Iven,
pairs.hanzi: 回客栈后，他先给米拉和伊文各写一页，

pairs.target: shuō zhé tóng de jiù hú yǒu duō dà , bēilǒu de rén zěnyàng zài chē biān děng ,
pairs.english: about how huge Zhetong's old arch was and how basket carriers waited beside the carts,
pairs.hanzi: 说折桐的旧弧有多大，背篓的人怎样在车边等，

pairs.target: yòu shuō zìjǐ yòng jiè xìng zhuāng hǎo le yìzhī kòujiàn , shùnshǒu de bāngmáng què láizì méi zài bái jiē xué guò de rén .
pairs.english: and how he had fitted a clasp using property borrowing, though the deft assistance came from someone who had never studied at White Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 又说自己用借性装好了一只扣件，顺手的帮忙却来自没在白阶学过的人。

pairs.target: zuìhòu cái xiě dēngé , xiě le liǎngháng hái juéde búgòu , lìng gěi sè lā tiān yìzhāng ,
pairs.english: Only at the end did he write about the lantern moths. Two lines still felt insufficient, so he added a separate sheet for Sela,
pairs.hanzi: 最后才写灯蛾，写了两行还觉得不够，另给瑟拉添一张，

pairs.target: shuō zhèlǐ yě yǒu búkào dēngyóu de liàng , zìjǐ kàn le hěn jiǔ , réng méi quán kàn míngbái .
pairs.english: saying there were lights here that needed no lamp oil; he had watched a long time and still had not understood them entirely.
pairs.hanzi: 说这里也有不靠灯油的亮，自己看了很久，仍没全看明白。

pairs.target: tā jiāng jǐfēngxìn jiāodào kèzhàn dài jì de lán lǐ , fù le qián , qǐng zhǎngguì míngzǎo suíchē dàizǒu .
pairs.english: He put the letters in the inn's outgoing basket, paid, and asked the innkeeper to send them with the morning cart.
pairs.hanzi: 他将几封信交到客栈代寄的篮里，付了钱，请掌柜明早随车带走。

pairs.target: tǎng xià shí , bìyǎn réng xiàng kànjiàn nàxiē qīnglǜ xiǎodiǎn .
pairs.english: When he lay down and closed his eyes, he still seemed to see those little blue-green specks.
pairs.hanzi: 躺下时，闭眼仍像看见那些青绿小点。

pairs.target: luó dí de shēngyīn cóng yuànlǐ chuánlái , zhèngzài gēn tángxiōng shuō jīnrì dìsānhuí shì zìjǐ ràng de , tǎ wéi gé chuāng hǎn le yìshēng húshuō , fānshēn xiào zhe shuì le .
pairs.english: Luodi's voice came from the courtyard: he was telling his cousin he had let Tavi win today's third round. Through the window Tavi shouted, “Rubbish!” Then he rolled over and fell asleep smiling.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻的声音从院里传来，正在跟堂兄说今日第三回是自己让的，塔维隔窗喊了一声胡说，翻身笑着睡了。
